trans-unit.source: When a replace changes a target segment, reset its status to Draft if it was Confirmed, Proofread or Approved. This makes the segments that Find & Replace touched easy to spot and re-check. Undo (Ctrl+Z) restores the original text and status together. Applies to Replace this, Replace all and F&R Sets batch runs.

Dotyczy opcji Zamień to, Zamień wszystko oraz wsadowych uruchomień zestawów F&R.

trans-unit.source: Replace all also makes the same change in the translation memories this project writes to (the TMs with Write ticked), so the old wording stops coming back as TM matches. You are shown how many TM entries will change before anything is done. TM changes cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z. Only Replace all does this, not Replace this.
